whiteLabelDemo.title: White-Label OS · Interactive preview
whiteLabelDemo.notice: This preview illustrates the proposed experience. It does not connect to a database or prove production isolation.
whiteLabelDemo.subtitle: A dedicated experience for each organisation, using the existing ImpactOS modules.
whiteLabelDemo.a1desc: A fictional cohort supporting early-stage teams from idea validation to a structured pitch.
whiteLabelDemo.a2desc: A fictional programme developing leadership and collaboration through guided workshops.
whiteLabelDemo.b1desc: A fictional university programme helping student founders structure an entrepreneurial project.
whiteLabelDemo.noResults: No matching programmes. Try another search.
whiteLabelDemo.deniedText: Programme content is hidden in this simulated scenario. Existing records are retained. Contact your organisation administrator.
whiteLabelDemo.mandateHint: An internal role alone is not sufficient. This switch simulates an explicit mandate for the selected organisation.
whiteLabelDemo.noMandateText: Client programmes remain hidden until an explicit, valid mandate is simulated.
whiteLabelDemo.auditEmpty: No simulated consultations yet. Open a programme while using supervision.
whiteLabelDemo.auditEvent: Programme consulted with a read mandate
whiteLabelDemo.auditBadge: Simulation only · nothing saved to the server
whiteLabelDemo.builtText: Organisation foundation, scoped programme read services, temporary supervision and consultation audit, additive migration checks.
whiteLabelDemo.previewText: Client branding, workspace selector, programme cards and access scenarios. These screens use fictional data; they are not connected to the backend.
whiteLabelDemo.remainingText: Complete indirect access checks, connect the client journey, validate the representative environment and obtain launch approval. The full build is not yet validated.
whiteLabelDemo.upcomingText: This module belongs to the agreed offer. Its client experience is not delivered in this preview. Programmes is the first implementation increment.
whiteLabelDemo.mock: Illustrative content · not a live programme
